note: Single source of the Animation IR (phase 7): 8 motion archetypes, which verbs ask for which, who leads and who follows, lags in sixteenth notes, easings, transitions. Python (scripts/animation_ir.py) and the browser (app/animation.js) read this file; app/animation-data.js is a copy made by node scripts/registry.mjs --write.

behaviors.lead: carries the move; everything else is read against it
behaviors.follow: the same move, softer and a few sixteenth notes late (follow-through)
behaviors.counter: the same move turning the other way
behaviors.ambient: slow matter that moves a little after the hero and never accents
behaviors.accent: does not move on its own; it shows the signal that moves the others
behaviors.reveal: enters on the build and clears before the loop ends
behaviors.hold: stays where it is so the eye has something that does not move

easings.spring: kick and ring: fast out, rings down (motion_profiles.py)
easings.steps: the phase is quantised: hard, interface-like steps
easings.ramp-drop: a slow linear build that drops at the end of the cycle
easings.linear-turn: constant speed, a whole turn per cycle
easings.damped: one entrance that settles without ringing

transitions.cut: phases change on the beat, no blend
transitions.ease: phases blend with a smooth ease
transitions.morph: phases flow into each other without a visible edge
transitions.hold: one phase holds while the others change

pulse.description: the hero is hit on the beat and rings out; the structure answers a sixteenth later

breathe.description: one slow breath every two bars; nothing is hit

glide.description: one continuous move per loop at a steady pace; no accent

surge.description: a slow build once per bar that drops at the end of the bar

stutter.description: quantised, hard steps on the beat; everything moves together, nothing rings

orbit.description: the hero turns once per loop and the structure turns the other way

ripple.description: a damped wobble that travels outward: hero first, then structure, then ground

settle.description: one entrance per loop that lands and holds; the rest stays still
